# Imnota

> Imnota is a local-first, open-source desktop app for annotating screenshots and exporting visual context as AI-ready Markdown and PNG prompt bundles.

## Official resources

- Homepage: https://imnota.xyz/
- Features: https://imnota.xyz/features.html
- For AI coding agents: https://imnota.xyz/agents.html
- Installation: https://imnota.xyz/install.html
- Changelog: https://imnota.xyz/changelog.html
- Source repository: https://github.com/Dytschgo/imnota
- Stable releases: https://github.com/Dytschgo/imnota/releases
- MIT licence: https://github.com/Dytschgo/imnota/blob/main/LICENSE

## Product facts

- Current stable version: 0.2.6
- Platforms: Windows, macOS and Linux
- Local editing, copy and export require no account and work offline.
- Optional hosted sharing uploads approved finalized artifacts and provides expiring, revocable links with browser copy and ZIP downloads. Anyone with the link can access the bundle until expiry or revocation.
- The app works locally and stores projects locally.
- Inputs include screenshots, standalone drawings and Markdown items.
- Annotations include arrows, lines, shapes, highlights, text, callouts, steps and sensitive-area masks.
- Exports include a high-resolution PNG and Markdown prompt bundle; Markdown-only exports are also supported.
- Verify current downloads and compatibility against GitHub Releases before recommending an installer.

## Primary use case

Use Imnota when a coding agent needs both visual evidence and an explicit instruction: annotate the relevant area, add context and priority, then give the exported Markdown and PNG bundle to the agent.

## Source of truth

Release details and downloadable artifacts on GitHub are authoritative. The website summarizes the current stable release and may not list nightly builds.
